description: This file implements the UserSettingsImplementation class, which manages user settings including reading, writing, and notifying changes. It interacts with a remote store object, handles configuration, registration of notifications, and provides getter/setter methods for various user settings.

classes.name: UserSettingsImplementation
classes.description: Implements user settings management, including configuration, notification registration, and getter/setter methods for various user preferences.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the user settings with the provided service, initializes remote store object, and registers event handlers.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for user setting changes.

methods.name: ValueChanged
methods.description: Handles value change notifications from the remote store and dispatches appropriate events.

methods.name: GetUserSettingsValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a user setting key from the remote store, falling back to default if not found.

methods.name: SetUserSettingsValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a user setting key in the remote store.

methods.name: GetAudioDescription
methods.description: Gets the current audio description setting.

methods.name: GetPreferredAudioLanguages
methods.description: Gets the preferred audio languages setting.

methods.name: SetPreferredAudioLanguages
methods.description: Sets the preferred audio languages setting.

methods.name: GetPreferredCaptionsLanguages
methods.description: Gets the preferred captions languages setting.

methods.name: SetPreferredCaptionsLanguages
methods.description: Sets the preferred captions languages setting.

methods.name: GetPreferredClosedCaptionService
methods.description: Gets the preferred closed caption service setting.

methods.name: SetPreferredClosedCaptionService
methods.description: Sets the preferred closed caption service setting.

methods.name: GetViewingRestrictionsWindow
methods.description: Gets the viewing restrictions window setting.

methods.name: SetViewingRestrictionsWindow
methods.description: Sets the viewing restrictions window setting.

methods.name: GetBlockNotRatedContent
methods.description: Gets the block not rated content setting.

methods.name: SetBlockNotRatedContent
methods.description: Sets the block not rated content setting.

methods.name: GetPinOnPurchase
methods.description: Gets the PIN on purchase setting.

methods.name: SetPinOnPurchase
methods.description: Sets the PIN on purchase setting.

methods.name: GetVoiceGuidanceHints
methods.description: Gets the voice guidance hints setting.

methods.name: SetVoiceGuidanceHints
methods.description: Sets the voice guidance hints setting.

methods.name: GetMigrationState
methods.description: Checks if a specific setting key requires migration.

methods.name: GetMigrationStates
methods.description: Retrieves migration states for all settings.
